recentItems.description:
Dil Bechara Brackup (2026 | South Hindi Dubbed Movie | Nani, Nithya Menen | Romantic Comedy Movie

Plot Summary
The Setup (Kidnap & Flashback): Gautham (Nani) is on his way to Bangalore to stop the wedding of his former girlfriend. En route, he is kidnapped by a man named John Abraham (Ashish Vidyarthi), who forces Gautham to narrate the entire story of his life and love.
The First Meeting: Gautham attends the wedding of his ex-girlfriend (who left him for someone else), where he meets Nithya (Nithya Menen). Nithya is also nursing a heartbreak after her boyfriend (a doctor) left her for someone else.
Friendship & Falling in Love: Bonding over their shared rejections, Gautham and Nithya become close friends. Over time, Gautham realizes he has fallen in love with Nithya, just as she gets engaged to her relative, Deepak. Gautham steps back to respect her engagement.
Misunderstandings & Complications: Nithya and her fiancé eventually call off their engagement because of her growing connection to Gautham. Meanwhile, Gautham briefly dates a veterinary doctor named Kavya. When Nithya goes to Gautham's house to confess her love (following a family tragedy), she mistakenly assumes Gautham and Kavya are married.
The Climax: Heartbroken by the misunderstanding, Nithya leaves for Bangalore to agree to a marriage arranged by her parents. Realizing what happened, Gautham and his friends rush to Bangalore to stop her wedding and finally unite.
